findings.message: Contoso.Catalog.Product.LegacyCode is written as 'legacY CODE' and becomes 'legacy CODE' on the target (camel case, site Contoso.Catalog.CatalogCodec.Write#1).
findings.recommendation: Pin the JSON name with [JsonProperty] (and NamingStrategy overrides off) if consumers depend on the old casing, or update them.
findings.note: 8.0.3: Fixed converting some property names to camel case; 11.0.1: Changed camel casing logic for all caps words to not leave last character capitalized

findings.message: Contoso.Catalog.Money implements ISerializable without [Serializable], and site Contoso.Catalog.MoneyCodec.Write#1 carries it.
findings.recommendation: Add [Serializable] to keep GetObjectData and the serialization constructor in use, or accept the public-member shape and convert stored data.
findings.note: 11.0.1: Types that implement ISerializable but don't have [SerializableAttribute] are not serialized using ISerializable

findings.message: Contoso.Catalog.Product.Stock is a dictionary keyed by an enum with [EnumMember], and site Contoso.Catalog.CatalogCodec.Write#1 carries it.
findings.recommendation: Stored JSON and consumers that use the enum names as keys must accept the [EnumMember] values, or remove [EnumMember] from the enum.
findings.note: 11.0.1: Changed enum serialization in dictionary keys to use EnumMemberAttribute

findings.message: This catches System.InvalidCastException from Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JToken.ToObject<decimal>(), which throws Newtonsoft.Json.JsonSerializationException on the target.
findings.recommendation: Catch the exception the target throws (or both, while both versions are in use).
findings.note: 13.0.1: Change InvalidCastException to JsonSerializationException on mismatched JToken

findings.message: A StringEnumConverter with AllowIntegerValues = false rejects integer strings and unnamed enum values on the target.
findings.recommendation: Payloads with integer strings ("1") for enums, or enum values without a name, now fail; accept them explicitly or clean the data.
findings.note: 10.0.1: Changed StringEnumConverter.AllowIntegerValues to also reject reading integer strings / writing enum values with no name

findings.message: Contoso.Catalog.Category contains itself, and site Contoso.Catalog.CategoryCodec.Read#1 reads it without MaxDepth: the target stops at 64 levels.
findings.recommendation: Set MaxDepth on the settings (or the reader) if payloads can nest deeper than 64 levels.
findings.note: 13.0.1: JsonReader and JsonSerializer MaxDepth defaults to 64

findings.message: Site Contoso.Catalog.CatalogCodec.Write#1 camel-cases the keys of Contoso.Catalog.Product.Attributes; keys with spaces after capitals change on the target ('URL VALUE' was 'urL VALUE', becomes 'url VALUE').
findings.recommendation: No code pattern shows whether the data is affected; the characterization probes with real payloads (`newtonsoft tests --samples`) will.
findings.note: 8.0.3: Fixed converting some property names to camel case; 11.0.1: Changed camel casing logic for all caps words to not leave last character capitalized

findings.message: 8.0.1: Changed parsing JArrays to not include comments by default: the release in use (comments-are-items) and the target (comments-skipped) differ for some input; the project has dom sites, the first is Contoso.Catalog.PriceReader.TryRead#1.
findings.recommendation: No code pattern shows whether the data is affected; the characterization probes with real payloads (`newtonsoft tests --samples`) will.
findings.note: 8.0.1: Changed parsing JArrays to not include comments by default
